scope: Core implementation requirements. Declarations and route inventory are not numerical qualification.

packages.qualification_task: Inventory remaining admission predicates and public entry points; measure accuracy, conservation, timing, allocation, memory and cancellation on committed builds.

Qualify residual, charge, derivative, noise, trial/accepted ownership and atomic restore contracts. Measure adapter overhead and cover all allocation owners, resource limits and allocator failure paths.

Separate setup, trial, acceptance, observation and checkpoint responsibilities while preserving exact event clocks, accepted grids, retry/rollback, checkpoint identity and continuation. Preserve integration-error control during startup Newton recovery; tests/tran_uic.rs qualifies adaptive charge accuracy against an analytical RC law, dialect-specific winding IC startup, constrained recovery, and packed coupled-winding continuation. tests/dc_topology_policy.rs covers winding IC bias and sweeps; pss_dependent_analysis.rs checks release of winding bias constraints into periodic descriptor equations.

Qualify exact-delay GP across polarities, dialects, bias regimes, feedback/private nodes, parameters, restart, resource limits and performance. tests/gp_feedback_weil.rs provides independent ngspice feedback oracles with intrinsic and nonlinear base resistance and packed adaptive continuation for Weil and exact delay, including UIC startup. Smooth nodal behavioral voltage and current sources have physical residual/Jacobian/time-partial equations. gp_phase_regimes includes independent GP/startup/nonlinear-decay/packed-continuation tests; nodal_voltage.rs adds implicit voltage feedback, nonlinear junction charge jumps and CCCS current/impulse fanout. Complete CCVS voltage-impulse descriptors, branch-current-controlled behavioral equations, switched/stateful behavioral providers and remaining device/instance support. Complete defined generalized interval algebra, nested integration and derived-expression propagation; diagnose undefined products and point domains. Add voltage-impulse and envelope observations, circuit assembly, nonlinear coupling and atomic acceptance. Guarded refusals do not constitute implemented support.

Complete the remaining 16 of 29 control dispositions, producer dependencies and bounded orchestration. DCMATCH preflights all candidate contributor values before displaced solves and report truncation; dcmatch_bounds_all_candidate_contributors_before_report_truncation guards the reproduced quota overrun. Preserve direct/control numerical equivalence, complex scalar bindings, physical units, immutable dataset identity and atomic publication. Extend qualification for earlier-card and eager-parameter temperatures, statistical/runtime binding, physical overrides, whole-run memory, cancellation, configuration and performance. Existing parser and analysis regression tests remain required.
Polynomial two-tone products and intercepts; unequal tones, coincidence, windows, dynamic range, noise and compression.
Public periodic residual, small-signal, shooting and envelope evidence per model/instance restriction, including conservation and independent references.

Public memory, switch, line and magnetic cases with event refinement, causal histories, conservation and continuation. transient_passive_currents::expression_capacitor_control_copy_preserves_the_manufactured_waveform checks the same nonlinear capacitance controlled directly or through a unity VCVS against an independent waveform and current law. The ordinary transient Newton Jacobian differentiates the discrete charge increment with accepted history fixed, including terminal and external controls. expression_capacitor_current_retains_small_increments_after_capacitance_changes checks small physical currents after a large voltage-controlled capacitance change, four integration methods, terminal polarity, IC branches and exact packed continuation. Current stamping and accepted histories retain charge increments independently of rounded absolute charge; legacy checkpoints without those increments are explicitly refused. Prescribed time-only capacitance uses Q=C(t)*V, while authored solution dependencies retain integral(C*dV). Public transient, HB, PSS, QPSS/QPAC and envelope capacitor regressions check independent product-charge currents, nested prescribed integrals and continuation without weakening numerical tolerances. device::passive::inductor::tests::inductor_companion_preserves_current_and_voltage_history checks the public direct-device transient stamp against analytical currents for both polarities, zero voltage, voltage history and changing steps.
DC reduction, modulated and correlated independent oracles, sideband convergence and integrated power.
Real runtime/generated/XSPICE models through core evaluators, complete state, operator-aware admission and rollback.
Coupled equilibrium, event ordering, rejected side effects and persisted deterministic continuation.
Analog/discrete period closure, moving-event derivatives, conversion, sampled noise and envelope evidence.
Every public route retains options, identity, units, errors, limits and producer state; compare transient observation routes.
Review responsibility boundaries and duplicate numerical contracts; measure memory, sparse scaling and hot-path changes.

Qualify committed builds across profiles/features with independent corpora, boundary fuzzing and failure atomicity. Resolve outstanding Windows compiler and wasm-bindgen runner reproducibility incidents; successful retries alone do not establish toolchain reliability.

guards.qualification_task: Public finite nonnegative delay execution replaces the blanket nonzero-PTF refusal; retain tested nonfinite, noncausal and unresolvable-arrival diagnostics.

Provide residual, charge, derivative, sided forcing, impulse and state equations for admissible devices accompanying exact-delay GP. Complete the remaining 22 absent families plus partially admitted CCVS and other instance predicates, including CCVS voltage impulses, branch-current control and switched/stateful expressions. Smooth nodal behavioral voltage and current equations are exercised through gp_phase_regimes with independent decay/GP equations, nonlinear voltage feedback, junction charge jumps, CCCS fanout and packed continuation. Native diode canonical F/Q, OP/UIC charge, finite lead currents, source/diode impulses, series resistance and packed restart now have regression coverage. tests/gp_phase_regimes/diodes.rs::gp_diode_smooth_model_terms_do_not_create_endless_delay_events guards the reproduced BV/IKF/ISR false-arrival abort with analytical delayed current, bounded steps and packed continuation; device event_regularity tests retain actual constitutive joins and check composite F/Q tangents across temperatures. tests/diode_native.rs checks the distinct Xyce injection current, tangent, TT charge and TIKF temperature scaling and dialect-specific AREA/M scaling with GMIN, recombination and sidewall terms; gp_xyce_diode_injection_preserves_charge_impulses_and_finite_currents verifies physical impulses and packed continuation. Xyce processed NBV defaults and EG/M bounds have independent DC/AC oracles; gp_xyce_diode_model_processing_preserves_current_charge_and_restart exercises those laws through forward/breakdown charge events and packed continuation. Public diode_hb_* regressions compare normalized M/FC charge currents and source conservation against independent spectral quadrature. Broader constitutive-join trajectories and parameter qualification remain open. Resistive-control CCVS equations, zero transresistance and independent voltage-source probes with a charge-free nodal sensing cutset are admitted without voltage impulses. Probe reduction reuses the canonical physical KCL, Jacobian and explicit time partial. Public gp_resistive_ccvs_* and gp_probe_ccvs_* tests exercise both probe orientations, floating references, nonlinear GP loads, regular rates, OP/UIC charge, current-impulse fanout and packed restart across dialects and integration methods; transient_transmission_line checks ordinary line waves and continuation. Storage or additional branch-current incidence at a sensing cutset remains explicitly excluded. Constant-linear circuits with constrained charge or flux use the authored full descriptor at transient source events and startup, retaining finite storage, voltage actions and every current derivative. Descriptor closure identifies circuits that actually need impulses; regular linear ODEs retain the ordinary integration and locked-grid contract. Independent current-driven winding and CCCS-driven winding oracles qualify flux jumps, mutual coupling, finite decay, voltage derivatives, authored OP/UIC state and packed continuation. tests/voltage_impulse_observations.rs checks picofarad differentiators, winding flux jumps, cascaded CCVS delta-prime voltages and second current derivatives, controlled-source projections, slope events, UIC, live observations, compression and packed continuation. Exact rational transition evaluation and exact incoming C*V/L*I products prevent spurious cancellation actions; native acceptance tests cover cancellation, resource refusal and atomic publication. Constant capacitor IC branches retain their own charge and current equations through finite-voltage GP and scalar-line events. tests/gp_phase_regimes/capacitor_ic.rs covers analytical RC startup and decay, differential polarity, zero capacitance, CCCS charge fanout and packed continuation; transient_transmission_line checks capacitor loading at a matched-line arrival. Smooth prescribed capacitance has physical Q=C(t)*V, explicit time partials, startup/periodic accepted state and finite/impulsive lead observations. gp_prescribed_capacitor_events_keep_product_charge_current_and_restart and gp_prescribed_capacitor_rc_decay_obeys_product_charge exercise polarity, multiplicity, OP/UIC, charge jumps, analytical decay and packed continuation. transient_transmission_line::prescribed_capacitor_load_preserves_the_analytic_line_arrival checks a changing-capacitance load against the matched-line solution and exact packed resume. Solution-controlled/stateful/switched capacitor event equations, nonlinear/GP CCVS voltage actions and PSS boundary observations remain open. Removing guards or skipping stamps does not establish support.
